A 3D view of capacity

Source: R/view3d.R
view_capacity_3d.Rd

An interactive map of a capacity result, each site raised to the height its envelope reaches and coloured by its capacity per hectare. With footprints = TRUE each storey's footprint is drawn at its own level instead, so the setbacks and planes show as the stepped form they make (practical for a few thousand sites). Hover a site for its figures. Needs the mapgl package; the basemap (OpenFreeMap's Positron, keyless) is fetched when the map is viewed.

Usage

view_capacity_3d(
  cap,
  measure = "floor_area",
  footprints = FALSE,
  style = NULL,
  pitch = 55,
  bearing = -20
)

Arguments

cap

A capacity result from estimate_capacity().

measure

The measure to colour by, per hectare of land.

footprints

Whether to draw each storey's footprint rather than the site raised to its height.

style

A MapLibre style; default OpenFreeMap's Positron.

pitch, bearing

The view angle.

Value

An htmlwidget (a mapgl map).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive() && rlang::is_installed("mapgl")
town <- exampleton()
sc <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
               parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ],
               roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
               zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "transit")])
view_capacity_3d(estimate_capacity(sc), footprints = TRUE)
}
